pricing_basis.method: Proposal-only monthly-billed subscription mix using listed SignalForge prices; excludes annual prepayments, tax, payment fees and refunds

caveats: No user-acquisition baseline or verified payment conversion data was provided.
Trial checkout currently saves selected plan during trial and must not be treated as collected cash.
Matured cohorts are 30+ days after signup, not total signups.
Retention factor is a simplifying assumption, not measured churn.
MRR is gross modeled recurring subscription value, not collected cash or profit.
initial_cohort_rule: First 30 days of new-user signups do not automatically generate cash under the present 30-day no-card trial; existing users/early paid upgrades are separate evidence-gated exceptions.
